answer.title: Black Adjustable LED Desk Lamp
answer.description: This black desk lamp features an adjustable articulated arm and a solid round base. It has an elongated lamp head emitting a bright white light and includes an attached power cable.
answer.pitch: Brighten your workspace with this sleek black adjustable desk lamp. It delivers flexible positioning and bright, focused illumination.

answer.title: Vintage Style SLR Film Camera in Silver and Black
answer.description: This manual SLR camera features a silver chrome top and base paired with a black textured body wrap. It is fitted with a central lens showing clear glass, along with top-mounted control dials and a prism viewfinder. The exterior is well-maintained with clean edges and minimal surface wear visible.
answer.pitch: Take a look at this classic silver and black SLR camera. It features a clean body with all original dials intact.

answer.title: 6-String Acoustic Guitar with Natural Finish
answer.description: This acoustic guitar features a natural wood finish soundboard accented by a black pickguard and a soundhole rosette. It is fully strung with six strings running over a dark fretboard and bridge. The body displays a traditional dreadnought shape in clean cosmetic condition.
answer.pitch: Check out this acoustic guitar featuring a natural wood finish. It is strung with six strings and ready to play.

answer.title: Brown Leather Flap Backpack with Front Pockets
answer.description: This brown leather backpack features a rounded top flap secured by a brass-tone buckle and a sturdy top carry handle. Two matching flap pockets with buckle straps sit on the lower front. The exterior shows neat perimeter stitching with a subtle mottled finish.
answer.pitch: Carry your essentials in classic style with this handsome brown backpack. It features twin front pockets and secure buckle closures.

answer.title: Vintage Mint Green Cruiser Bike with Wicker Basket
answer.description: This cruiser bike features a mint green front fender and frame paired with a front wicker basket and a brown saddle. The chrome handlebars include brown grips, a black bell, and a right-hand brake lever. Noticeable cosmetic wear, chipped paint, and rust are visible on the fender and wheel spokes.
answer.pitch: Ride in classic style with this vintage green cruiser featuring a front wicker basket. Check it out and make an offer today!

answer.title: Himalayan Salt Rock Lamp on Wooden Base
answer.description: This natural salt rock lamp is carved with an organic texture and mounted on a dark wooden base. When turned on, the internal light casts a soft, warm orange glow. A power cord extends from the back of the base.
answer.pitch: Bring a cozy atmosphere to your space with this Himalayan salt lamp. It lights up with a warm amber tone.
